Hi all — I reviewed the request. Redaction plan below; happy to proceed once legal signs off on the final PDF: 

Redaction scope (recommended):
- Remove all customer-identifying metadata (customer names, IPs, API keys).
- Strip full vulnerability reproduction steps where doing so could enable re-exploitation; retain high-level vulnerability descriptions, severity, and remediation recommendations.
- Keep test methodology, dates (anonymized to month/year only), and summary of test coverage (components, environments).

Deliverables we will produce:
1) Executive summary (1 page) — included inline for quick upload.
2) Redacted PT report (PDF) — will include appendix numbers that map to SIG/CAIQ controls.
3) SIG mapping spreadsheet (XLSX) — control ID -> report section/page or appendix name.
4) Remediation status CSV — columns: finding_id, severity, status (Closed/In progress/Planned), owner, eta.

We will attach stub filenames and include a short MD5 hash in the portal for integrity. Ill upload to the HealthGrid GRC link you provided unless you prefer a secure share via our encryption bucket.

Vanessa Ortiz
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference

- 09:00 PDT: Executive summary (pasted below) and remediation CSV for quick portal fields.
- 11:30 PDT: Upload redacted PDF (Redwood_PT_Report_v2_redacted.pdf) + sig_mapping_sheet_healthgrid.xlsx to HealthGrid GRC portal. Ill add a short note in the portal pointing to the mitigation log.

Executive summary (paste for portal):
Redwood Inference completed an independent penetration test of the hosted inference environment in April 2027. The assessment covered control plane web interfaces, admin APIs, and the customer-facing inference endpoints in our US region. The test identified 12 findings (2 high, 4 medium, 6 low). High findings were related to a third-party dependency and an edge case in session handling; both have mitigations deployed and are verified in staging. A complete remediation log is attached. Redacted artifacts mapped to SIG controls are provided in the accompanying spreadsheet.

Attachment stubs (will be uploaded):
- Redwood_PT_Report_v2_redacted.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB)
